blindness_caveat: A general web search for 'Tesla mergers acquisitions history SolarCity Twitter' returned an M&A-aggregator page (VectorShift) that explicitly quotes 10-K and 8-K exhibit text, alongside independent sources (Utility Dive, Fast Company, Harvard Business School case study). The events below are dated/scoped from Utility Dive and Fast Company only; the real 8-K Item 1.01/2.01 text was fetched afterward, during diagnostic testing of the extraction patterns, not used to write this gold record.
note: Scoped to the 2016 SolarCity merger only (announced 2016-08-01, closed 2016-11-21) -- Tesla's other real acquisitions (Maxwell Technologies 2019, Grohmann Engineering 2017) are documented but not included in this first pass. Picked deliberately as a large, well-documented deal using the same 'entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger' phrasing and multi-party-with-shell (Tesla, SolarCity, D Subsidiary Inc.) structure already fixed for Six Flags -- a generalization check as much as a fresh test.

events.notes: Merger Agreement signed; all-stock deal, 0.110 Tesla shares per SolarCity share, ~$2.6B announced value
Closing; SolarCity became a wholly owned subsidiary of Tesla, delisted from NASDAQ (ticker SCTY)
